action_cell: DATO/INFERENZA: remove a measured percent of the isolated NMDAR EPSC and read burst incidence against percent removed. d-APV is the reference; the curve itself defines the burst-abolishing percent (the unknown x).
compound_or_probe_cell: d-APV: used at 50 uM in the source paper (DATO, 34634460); mechanism as a competitive, surmountable antagonist is CARRIED, no source read in this package bears on it; subunit preference mild (carried compilation). Qualified for use as reference once x is measured; not qualified as a subunit probe.
outcome_unresolved_cell: INFERENZA: Coincident NAM and d-APV curves over a range shorter than x: compatible with total gain and with a subunit-agnostic threshold; no discrimination. INFERENZA: a NAM that stops at its own ceiling below x is also what a GluN2A or NAM-insensitive-triheteromer pool would give, so it does not strengthen total gain over them.

action_cell: INFERENZA: a GluN2B NAM at saturating exposure removes at most 0.88 x f(2B) + 0.32 x f(tri) of the current (D09); burst fall at a smaller percent removed than d-APV needs (curve left of the d-APV curve) would say GluN2B-containing receptors weigh more than their current share; a plateau means the NAM-sensitive pool is exhausted.
compound_or_probe_cell: Ifenprodil: mechanism read in a primary source for the diheteromer and triheteromer maxima (24607230: 88 and 32 percent); abstract-level only for Williams. Ro 25-6981: primary full text NOT reached; abstract values only (9 nM vs 52 uM), maximum inhibition and conditions unread; its triheteromer behaviour is transferred from ifenprodil and CP-101,606 (INFERENZA). Radiprodil (carried, 40994429 Table 1): rat GluN1/GluN2B 82 vs rat triheteromer 45 percent (human GluN1/GluN2B 91). Identity of the best NAM: unresolved between ifenprodil (read, but alpha-1 and sigma actions carried unverified) and Ro 25-6981 (carried as more selective, primary unread).
outcome_unresolved_cell: INFERENZA: A plateau below abolition: it cannot separate a GluN2A-diheteromer pool from an insensitive triheteromer pool without the TCN-201 arm (D04, D09).

action_cell: INFERENZA: a GluN2A-preferring NAM lowers the isolated EPSC and the burst more at low than at high co-agonist (internal specificity control from the earlier reading of 22553026, carried); on triheteromers it removes up to 72 percent, so a large effect does not prove diheteromers.
compound_or_probe_cell: TCN-201: identity qualified for GluN2A-containing receptors by Hansen (91 percent on diheteromers, 72 percent on triheteromers, none on GluN2B diheteromers) and by 22553026 (carried: glycine-dependent, solubility limit 18 uM). Not qualified for slice use: no slice co-agonist or tonic Zn2+ datum.
outcome_unresolved_cell: INFERENZA: A partial fall: shared between GluN2A diheteromers and triheteromers (maximum 72 percent) and between co-agonist state and subunit.

action_cell: INFERENZA: an AMPA antagonist and d-APV, each titrated to the same measured fraction of evoked charge (and on a second metric), give coincident burst curves; AMPA block also removes the depolarisation that relieves Mg2+ block, so abolition alone is not informative.
compound_or_probe_cell: IDENTITY UNRESOLVED. Perampanel is the only AMPA compound whose mechanism was read earlier (carried, 25229608: noncompetitive, culture, slow kinetics); NBQX and GYKI 52466 are use-only or carried; no AMPA-antagonist mechanism paper was read in this package by instruction. Datum that would resolve it: a primary selectivity paper for the chosen compound plus a measured fast-EPSC block in these slices.
outcome_unresolved_cell: INFERENZA: Different metrics giving different orderings (charge is dominated by the slow NMDAR component).

action_cell: IPOTESI: the NMDAR dependence is due to the slice's depolarised resting potential and Mg2+ relief, not to receptor composition; the drug curves shift together when Mg2+ or K+ is varied.
compound_or_probe_cell: No compound: bath Mg2+ and K+ are the manipulation (not a drug); d-APV and the NAM read at two measured Mg2+ levels.
outcome_unresolved_cell: INFERENZA: Shifts of unequal size (partial state dependence).
